items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: My father was on records with us, too.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. My father was on records with us, too. Uh-huh.
Uh, what name was the band down there? Do you remember?

items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I did teach boys how to play. My son happened to be one.

ctx.x: Is your son's name Richard too?
No, my oldest son... The one that plays guitar? I did have a son named Richard, but he died long years ago. And this boy I have now, my oldest boy now, his name is Ernest.
Ernest, the one that plays guitar?
